inputs.caption: Chinese-style (zhongguo feng) cinematic pop ballad in the spirit of Jay Chou's "Fireworks Cool Easily": melancholy minor key, around 72 BPM, modern R&B-tinged vocal phrasing and relaxed rhythmic delivery, ancient Jiangnan storytelling mood, dramatic and epic but intimate. GRAND CINEMATIC INTRO (about 14 seconds): distant rain ambience, a lone dizi motif, deep taiko-style drum hits, a sweeping guzheng glissando, strings rising in a slow crescendo, building real momentum before the vocal enters. Male lead vocal: warm, slightly nasal tenor with clear expressive Chinese enunciation, conversational phrasing in the verses, restrained at first, then a PASSIONATE, soaring, high-energy chorus with layered harmonies, octave doubling and tasteful ad-libs; the chorus must be simple, repetitive, hooky and instantly memorable, easy to sing along after one listen. Instruments: dizi, xiao, guzheng, pipa, erhu, grand piano, cinematic strings, taiko drums, plus a subtle modern sub bass and soft programmed R&B drums to modernize the groove. Structure: grand intro, intimate verse, building pre-chorus, huge catchy chorus, second verse with pipa, pre-chorus, chorus, a stripped bridge with piano and xiao, a final bigger chorus with full harmonies and ad-libs, then a quiet outro of dizi and rain. Mood: epic, sorrowful, nostalgic, unfulfilled love across ten years. Mix: wide cinematic reverb, punchy but clean low end, vocal forward. No rap, no screaming, no EDM drops, no heavy rock guitars.
inputs.lyrics:
[Intro]
（大鼓·古筝·笛）
Ah…
江南 烟雨
Ah…
十年 一梦

[Verse 1]
青石巷 落满杏花香
乌篷船 摇过旧时光
你撑伞 等在石桥旁
我一身风霜 不敢抬头望

[Pre-Chorus]
雨落青檐 打湿你的衣衫
一句借伞 换了半生牵绊
我笑说 江湖太远太宽
不敢许你 一个明天

[Chorus]
烟雨纷纷 落满了江南城
我听闻 你还在渡口等
一盏灯 一个人 十年整
等成我 心口最疼的回声
十年风尘 换不回一次转身
我提剑 也斩不断这缘分
若来生 能重写这段前尘
我愿把 江湖换你一程

[Verse 2]
再回江南 杏花依旧飞扬
石桥下的水 还是那样凉
船家说 有位姑娘 年年守望
一把旧伞 撑过十载风霜

[Pre-Chorus]
我不敢 走近你的伞沿
怕一身风雪 唐突你的眼
你却先 抬头轻轻唤
声音 还是当年的雨点

[Chorus]
烟雨纷纷 落满了江南城
我听闻 你还在渡口等
一盏灯 一个人 十年整
等成我 心口最疼的回声
十年风尘 换不回一次转身
我提剑 也斩不断这缘分
若来生 能重写这段前尘
我愿把 江湖换你一程

[Bridge]
若当年 我没走
是不是 就能白首
可江湖 从不留人
把剑 换成你的手

[Final Chorus]
烟雨纷纷 落满了江南城
我听闻 你还在渡口等
一盏灯 一个人 十年整
等成我 心口最疼的回声
十年风尘 换不回一次转身
我提剑 也斩不断这缘分
若来生 能重写这段前尘
我愿把 江湖换你一程
Ah… 烟雨纷纷

[Outro]
你的伞 还偏向左边
那是我 站过的位置
十年了 雨没停
我也 没走
